# 行舟 · 个人项目与事务中心 v0.1.1

这是一次安全删除更新。行舟现在可以从各个工作项入口直接删除属性视图条目，同时明确保护关联文档和现有层级关系。

## 新增

- 在“全部”“本周”“收件箱”“整理”的列表、层级树和卡片中右键打开统一工作项菜单。
- 支持删除长期领域、项目、任务、事务和想法。
- 删除前必须经过二次确认。
- 若目标仍有下级工作项或“所属顶层项目”引用，确认框会显示数量和关系整理提示。

## 数据与安全边界

- 删除只移除目标思源属性视图条目。
- 已绑定的思源文档只解除数据库绑定，文档本身不会被删除。
- 下级工作项不会被级联删除，其他条目的关系也不会被静默改写。
- 删除后会重新读取属性视图，确认目标行确实已经消失。
- 输入框、文本域和可编辑区域继续保留系统原生右键菜单，方便复制与粘贴。

## 安装

请下载本 Release 附件中的 `package.zip`。不要使用 GitHub 自动生成的 Source code 压缩包作为思源插件包。

完整记录见 [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Yong2Sheng/siyuan-plugin-xingzhou/blob/v0.1.1/CHANGELOG.md)。

# Xingzhou · Personal Projects & Tasks v0.1.1

This release adds a protected deletion workflow. Work items can now be removed directly from their interface surfaces while linked documents and existing hierarchy relations remain explicitly protected.

## Added

- Open one consistent work-item menu by right-clicking list, hierarchy-tree, and card surfaces across All, Week, Inbox, and Review.
- Delete long-term areas, projects, tasks, transactions, and ideas.
- Require a second confirmation before deletion.
- Warn with counts when descendants or top-project references will remain.

## Data and safety boundary

- Deletion removes only the target SiYuan Attribute View row.
- A bound SiYuan document is merely unbound and is never deleted.
- Descendants are not deleted recursively, and relation references are not silently rewritten.
- Xingzhou reloads the Attribute View after deletion to verify that the target row is gone.
- Inputs, textareas, and editable regions retain the native context menu for copying and pasting.

## Installation

Download the attached `package.zip`. Do not use GitHub's automatically generated source-code archives as the SiYuan plugin package.

See [CHANGELOG.en.md](https://github.com/Yong2Sheng/siyuan-plugin-xingzhou/blob/v0.1.1/CHANGELOG.en.md) for the complete record.
